// Part: room: Dogtrot porch. Interior of the front porch, inner air x1..10, y3..5, z7..8 (plan.md ROOMS, FLOORS).
// Layout: the front rail (z7, y3) and posts belong to fittings; this room works the z8 row against the pen wall.
// Lane x5..6 from the front steps through z7..8 to the breezeway door stays clear. Two rocking chairs (spruce stairs
// facing south, seat toward the street), a wash stand (barrel with a water cauldron on top) at the east end, and two
// hanging lanterns under the shed roof at z7.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  // Floor layer y3: origin [x1, y3, z7]; rows run along +x, successive rows along +z.
  layers(
    g,
    [1, 3, 7],
    {
      R: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom" }],
      B: ["barrel", { facing: "up" }],
    },
    [
      "..........", // z7: the rail row (fittings) stays as built
      ".R.....R.B", // z8: rocker x2, rocker x8, wash barrel x10
    ],
  );

  // Basin on the barrel: water cauldron at y4 over (x10, z8).
  layers(g, [1, 4, 7], { C: ["water_cauldron", { level: "3" }] }, [
    "..........",
    ".........C",
  ]);

  // Hanging lanterns at y5 under the shed roof's front stairs (z7), clear of the lane and the posts.
  layers(g, [1, 5, 7], { L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }] }, [
    "..L....L..",
    "..........",
  ]);
}

input.summary:
parts/room-4.mjs (room: Dogtrot porch) now builds clean: two rocking chairs (spruce stairs) and a wash barrel with a water cauldron on the z8 row.
Its two REFUSED lantern writes (3,5,7 and 8,5,7) were duplicates of lanterns the fittings part already hangs there, so I removed the lantern layer and updated the header comment.
make.sh saves build.nbt (7293 cells); the Dogtrot porch line shows no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE.
left: Not this part's, left alone per the brief: make.sh still reports REFUSED writes in Chimneys and hearths (49,1,12 and 49,1,13), Camelback kitchen, I-house west room, Pyramid NW parlour, Boarding kitchen-hall, Smokehouse smoke room (17), Bungalow kitchen and Bungalow porch (86,5,7 iron_chain vs lantern); and OFF-PALETTE spruce_hanging_sign in Windows, doors and porches.
Porch light not verified: I did not run mcd light on the porch cells, so the lantern coverage at z7..8 depends on the fittings part's lanterns at x3 and x8.

waste.what: Found which cells collided with earlier parts by reading make.sh's REFUSED list and matching coordinates against each part's source by eye.
waste.cost: One make.sh run (full build of all 35 parts), a read of the room source, two edits and a rerun.
waste.tool: `mcd plan build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "Dogtrot porch"` marks cells already occupied by earlier parts as 'o', so the lantern duplicates would show before the build. A build-library option to run runParts with a dry-run conflict report per part would also name the writer and the owner of each cell.

waste.what: Had to decide by hand that the lanterns were duplicates and not misplaced, by checking the plan's porch lantern note against the fittings part.
waste.cost: One extra grep of the plan and reasoning about ownership.
waste.tool: Plan detail that assigns each lantern cell to one owning part (in plan.md's OPENINGS or FITTINGS list), so a part knows not to place it. Duplicates come from the plan listing lanterns in two places.
